figures.caption: Three-dimensional structure of PaD (left) and Ct_PaD (right) as predicted by AlphaFold [17]. https://colab.research.google.com/github/deepmind/alphafold/blob/main/notebooks/AlphaFold.ipynb: accessed on 12 April 2022. Tertiary structures are represented using MOE software: Helix is red, β-strand is in yellow, turn is in blue, and ribbon loop is in gray. Disulfide bonds are displayed in yellow.

figures.caption: Oxidative folding of PaD and Ct_PaD. (A) RP-HPLC elution profile of purified peptides, with (inset) the respective LC-MS spectrum: [M + 5H]5+ (m/z 853.10) and [M + 4H]4+ (m/z 1065.85) for PaD (Left), and: [M + 5H]5+ (m/z 561.30), [M + 4H]4+ (m/z 701.40) and [M + 4H]3+ (m/z 934.85) for Ct_PaD (Right). (B) Overlaid RP-HPLC elution profiles of natural and synthetic PaD samples.
figures.label: Figure 2

figures.caption: Toxicity analysis. (A) Hemolytic activity in horse red blood. (B) Viability of hepatic cells (MRC-5) upon peptide treatment for 4 h. Data points for PaD and Ct_PaD peptides are depicted in green and red. Results are the average of three replicates. LL-37 was used as a reference peptide.
figures.label: Figure 3

figures.caption: Stability of peptides in human serum. Peptide extinction curves over time of PaD and Ct_PaD were obtained by integration of chromatogram peaks in Figure S3. The t1/2s, estimated by experimental data fitting to an exponential decay model, are the mean of three experiments, with a 95% CI.
figures.label: Figure 4

figures.caption: Ribbon representation of the PaD structure. (Left) Lowest target function conformer of the final NMR structure (Right) Alpha-fold predicted structure. Disulfide bonds are displayed in yellow. Loops 15–32 are highlighted in magenta.

figures.caption: Ct_PaD structure. Lowest target function conformers of the NMR structures were calculated for disulfide pairing 2–19 and 12–18 (left) and for disulfide pairing 2–18 and 12–19 (right).
